integrity_statement: General claims are established analytically; exact-rational finite verification is supplementary. The source model and classical induced-rotation technique are credited, and priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Area formulas cover only the open interpolating trapezoid of the three-cone identity-permutation family.
Pointwise boundary behavior depends on an interval-exchange endpoint convention; all area results are unaffected.
Irrational unique ergodicity is fiberwise and does not assert ergodicity on the entire two-dimensional invariant set.
A differently formulated predecessor of the exact period-area law cannot be excluded conclusively.
title: Exact period-area spectrum for an interpolating translated cone exchange
